Clear signage, explained for anyone travelling with a pet
They often ask us about it

Clear signage for pet travel

Clear signage matters because it helps every traveler move through the Companion Animal Travel Desk process without extra stress. At Aurelia Skyways, the signs near check-in, waiting areas, and boarding points are there to guide the whole handoff from desk to gate. Keep an eye on them as soon as you arrive.

Read each sign slowly and follow the route shown for pet acceptance, document checks, and boarding support. If you are carrying a pet carrier, watch for notices that point to the correct desk and any nearby waiting spot. The welcome team uses those signs to help passengers line up in the right place and keep the flow calm.

Staff also record service changes in the desk ledger, so signs may reflect the most recent guidance. If a notice changes, follow the newest one and do not rely on an older direction from memory. The cabin team then uses the updated record to monitor animals during flight and keep the journey steady.

If you are traveling with Daisy, or with any other pet, do not leave the marked path to look for shortcuts. That can slow boarding and cause confusion for other travelers. The service works best when each journey is treated as a shared responsibility, with everyone following the same clear instructions.

If the sign is hard to read, ask a desk agent right away and keep your pet close while you wait for help. More help is available from the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
